name: Adventurer: Mage and Mage
description: A spellcaster who follows two traditions at once, trading depth for range. You roll a d6 with a -1 class penalty at first level, gain one free Focus of any kind, and learn the arts and spells of both traditions.

template_requirements.missing_message: a Mage/Mage Adventurer must choose two partial traditions
template_requirements.duplicate_message: a Mage/Mage Adventurer must choose two different traditions
